response.sql: WITH matched_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), baseline_rebate AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) as baseline_avg_rebate FROM matched_fees), group_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) as avg_relative_gap FROM matched_fees GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT gs.orderslink, gs.ordertune, gs.avg_rebate, gs.avg_relative_gap, gs.avg_rebate - br.baseline_avg_rebate as excess_over_baseline FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN baseline_rebate br WHERE gs.avg_rebate > br.baseline_avg_rebate ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
